File exists', wedging checkout_initialization and blocking read-only /api/v1/ui/snapshot. Adds cleanup_stale_git_ref_locks + best-effort reap before the state-branch fetch (same predicates as index.lock: managed-root + >=5min + no-holder + no-active-git). msm-2 reviewed clean; through the gate.
